analysis.completeRound: One accepted stake and one settled draw; no bonus continuations or additional paid choices.
analysis.settlement: Exact integer stake units multiplied by 0, 2 or 36. No rounding loss at any positive integer stake.
analysis.allPositiveIntegerStakes: For stake s, the sum of returns over 37 equally likely outcomes is exactly 36*s for every available choice.
analysis.boundsKind: Exact exhaustive bounds. Sampling confidence intervals are not used for the analytical RTP.
